projects.title: Integrated Security for Corporate Headquarters
projects.summary: End-to-end security platform unifying CCTV, access control, and visitor management across a 14-floor corporate tower with executive-floor restrictions.
scope: 120+ IP cameras with edge analytics across all floors and parking
Access control on 80+ doors with executive-floor anti-passback
Visitor management with QR-pass workflow
Centralized VMS and access platform with single sign-on
projects.outcome: Single-pane-of-glass security operations with sub-2-second event correlation between video and access events.

projects.title: Hotel Access Control & Guest Experience
projects.summary: Mobile-credential access control system across guest rooms, staff areas, and back-of-house, integrated with the property management system.
scope: BLE / mobile-key access control on 220 guest rooms
Tiered staff access for housekeeping, F&B, and management zones
PMS integration for automated check-in / check-out provisioning
Audit logging and lost-credential lockout workflows
projects.outcome: Eliminated physical-key reissuance overhead; reduced guest check-in time by 40% via mobile-key delivery.

projects.title: Hospital-Wide Surveillance & Restricted Access
projects.summary: Multi-zone surveillance with restricted-area access control covering pharmacy, server room, neonatal unit, and patient records archives.
scope: 180 IP cameras across patient, clinical, and back-office areas
Biometric-only access on pharmacy and controlled-substance storage
Tamper-proof recording with 90-day retention compliance
Real-time anti-loitering and unauthorized-area alerts
projects.outcome: Compliance-grade audit trails for regulated areas; integrated alerts reduced response time to restricted-zone breaches.

projects.title: Manufacturing Plant Time & Attendance
projects.summary: Multi-shift biometric attendance system with payroll integration for a 600-person manufacturing facility operating three shifts.
scope: 12 fingerprint + face terminals across plant entrances
Shift-based scheduling with overtime and break tracking
Direct integration with payroll and ERP systems
Productivity reporting per line, shift, and supervisor
projects.outcome: Eliminated buddy-punching; cut payroll processing time by 60%; produced audit-ready compliance reports.

projects.title: Office Build-Out: Network & Low-Current
projects.summary: Full structured cabling, fiber backbone, switching, and Wi-Fi for a 4,500 m² office fit-out — engineered for 350 workstations and AV-heavy meeting rooms.
scope: Cat6A horizontal cabling certified per TIA/EIA-568 standards
OM4 fiber backbone with redundant ring topology
Managed PoE+ switching with VLANs for voice, data, and AV
Wi-Fi 6 coverage with site-survey-validated heat map
projects.outcome: Day-one full network availability; certified install with manufacturer warranty pass-through.

projects.title: Campus Entrance Control Deployment
projects.summary: Speed-gate turnstile deployment at campus main entrances with student / staff credential integration and visitor QR-pass workflow.
scope: Speed gates at 4 main campus entrances (12 lanes total)
RFID + mobile credential authentication
Visitor pre-registration with QR-pass issuance
Anti-tailgating sensors with central monitoring station
projects.outcome: Throughput of 40 persons/lane/minute during peak hours; full audit log of campus ingress and egress.
